title: Document registry, versions, licensing and trust

verified_properties: source bytes are copied into immutable content-addressed snapshots
source SHA-256 must match the supplied canonical DocumentManifest
document and version identities are append-only and conflict checked
version lineage must reference a registered version of the same paper
exact retries reuse the original immutable record
license_status and access_policy_ref propagate without permissive inference
provisional_implementation.claim_boundary: The implementation is provisional because its input is a complete final DocumentManifest, while the canonical workflow builds that artifact only after registration, integrity scanning, metadata resolution, parsing, reconciliation, and SourceSpan emission.

python.cause: The repository does not lock the product-owner-selected exact tiktoken==0.13.0 contract in pyproject.toml and uv.lock.

shared_contract_gap.summary: The first corpus-ingest node is required to register source bytes before the final DocumentManifest exists, but the only canonical document artifact requires results produced by later nodes.
unresolved_contracts: canonical initial source-registration artifact and its exact fields
relationship and immutable lineage between initial registration and final DocumentManifest
exact business input and output of register_document under NodeInvocation and ResultEnvelope wrapping
persistence, effect, ArtifactReceipt, and ledger ownership among K01, D03, and the workflow caller
runtime adapter from component root python/epistemic_foundry to installable src/epistemic_foundry
exact workflow, schema, runtime, persistence, and test owners plus bounded write-scope corrections

classification.not_fail_reason: The provisional implementation and both K01 required checks pass; the blocking issue is a contradictory lifecycle contract outside K01 write scope, not a known implementation defect.
classification.not_blocked_reason: No required credential, licensed source, host capability, external service, or tool is unavailable.
classification.fail_closed_reason: Selecting or inventing an initial artifact, persistence owner, receipt boundary, or runtime adapter would expand authority and could create a false source-provenance chain.

required_product_owner_decisions: Define the canonical initial source-registration artifact, its exact required fields, and whether it is a new schema or an existing artifact projection.
Define the immutable relationship, identifiers, hashes, and supersession lineage between initial registration and the final DocumentManifest.
Freeze register_document business input/output and its NodeInvocation, ResultEnvelope, ArtifactReceipt, and expected-effect bindings.
Assign durable source-byte persistence, registry state, effect, receipt, and Noetic Ledger ownership across K01, D03, and the workflow caller.
Assign the runtime adapter or package projection that exposes epistemic_foundry.ingest.registry from the installable src layout.
Authorize the minimum exact workflow, schema, runtime, persistence, fixture, and test paths required for a resolving K01 attempt.

review.assurance_limitation: The product owner prohibited Fleet and subagents. Review is procedurally separate within the primary session and is not actor-independent certification.

rah_state.reason_not_mutated: The existing RAH state is forensically blocked by unresolved J02 tokenizer-lock and S04 traceability failures; K01 does not rewrite or advance it.
